summary.text: Zach Payne is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 66, which he has represented since November 2020, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Ryan Price as his opponent in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Zach Payne lives in Charlestown, Indiana.
He earned a B.S. in business administration from Charter Oak State College and an M.B.A. from the University of Southern Indiana.
His career experience includes serving as the Clark County recorder and owning a business.
Payne took office on November 4, 2020, succeeding Terry Goodin.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him on the Education and Employment, Labor and Pensions committees and as vice chair of the Elections and Apportionment Committee.
